This is a small follow-up to v0.8.0 that tidies up Update > Omarchy on existing installs.

After moving to v0.8.0, Update > Omarchy could print "Installation aborted" for the camera and battery modules, then ask to reboot for a new kernel every time it ran. Neither one was a real problem, but both looked like one. Both are fixed, and your next Update > Omarchy picks up the fix.

[Download Try Omarchy for Windows](https://tryomarchy.com/download)
